capital.title: Saudi IPO woes continue as contractor withdraws offering
capital.description: Saudi contractor Mutlaq Al-Ghowairi Contracting Company (MGC) has withdrawn an initial public offering that could have raised $800 million. The IPO, which stood to be the third on the main market this year, would have been easily the largest so far. The number of new offerings has slumped following the outbreak of the Iran war. […]
